1268 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
09-25-1268 minus 141 days:  
Back up 141 days = go back into previous months.  
September has 30 days, so back 25 days to Sep 1 leaves 116 days more.  
August (31), July (31), June (30) total 92 days, leaving 24 days before June 1.  
May has 31 days, so May 31 minus 24 days = May 7.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1268-05-07
